verdict: Three requested items resolved. No additional blocking scientific/algebra change. Formal launch must use recorded absolute start/deadline and matching external timeout; this reviewer has not inspected launch command/result.

safe_rho handles empty/single/constant/nonfinite within-band Spearman as null; initial overall correlation already guarded.
